title: Future Jobs
subtitle: Dream big. Plan your next chapter.
description: Career choices, future plans, job interviews and the first steps towards your dream job.

activities.title: Family jobs
answers: My father is an engineer, and my mother is a teacher.

activities.title: A list of jobs
answers: Teacher, doctor, nurse, engineer, architect, dentist, accountant, lawyer, chef, pilot, journalist, software developer.

activities.title: The most interesting job
answers: I think being a software developer is the most interesting job because I enjoy solving problems and creating useful apps.

activities.title: Popular jobs in the near future
answers: I would tick information security analyst, biomedical engineer and solar energy technician. People will need secure systems, better healthcare and clean energy.

activities.title: CV and letter of intent
answers: CV = curriculum vitae. Résumé is another word for CV.
A letter of intent is an application letter or cover letter in this context.

activities.title: Vocabulary
answers: degree: a university qualification — üniversite diploması
vacancy: an available job — açık kadro / boş pozisyon
schedule: arrange a time — zamanını planlamak

activities.title: Put the pictures in order
answers: 1. c — Graduate and get a degree.
3. d — Send a CV and letter of intent.
4. a — Contact the company and schedule an interview.

activities.title: Act out the phone call
answers: Practise the conversation in activity 4 using the completed answers. Then swap the HR manager and candidate roles.
activities.note: Use the book dialogue; a new role-play model is provided on page 18.

activities.title: Correct the mistakes
answers: Robin applied for the vacant position of web designer at the company.
The human resources manager first wanted to schedule the interview for next Monday.
Robin could not attend at 2 p.m. on Monday because he had an appointment with the dentist.
They finally agreed to schedule the interview for 19 October.

activities.title: Predict the interview questions
answers: I think the interviewer will ask about Robin’s education, strengths and reasons for wanting the job.

activities.title: Discuss the questions
answers: 1. Yes, I would employ Robin. He is qualified, hardworking and good at teamwork.
2. Yes. Doing our best helps us improve our skills and reach our goals.
3. No, I haven’t had a temporary job yet. I’m planning to work in a café next summer.

activities.title: A phone conversation
answers: HR: Good morning. How can I help you?
Candidate: I’m Deniz Kaya. I applied for the web designer position. Could we schedule an interview?
HR: Certainly. Are you available on Tuesday at 10?
Candidate: I’m sorry, I have a class then. Could we meet at 2?
HR: Yes, that’s fine. See you on Tuesday at 2.
Candidate: Thank you. Have a nice day.

activities.title: Swap roles: another short model
answers: Candidate: Hello, I’m Ece Yılmaz. I’m calling about the engineer position.
HR: Can you come on Wednesday at 11?
Candidate: Yes, that’s fine by me. Thank you.
HR: You’re welcome. See you then.

activities.title: Present and record
answers: Present one of the model conversations with your partner. Ask a classmate to record it, then upload it as instructed by your teacher.

activities.label: Video Blog 1
activities.title: Are video blogs useful in English?
answers: Yes. Video blogs help us practise speaking, notice our mistakes and see our progress.

activities.label: Video Blog 2
activities.title: A brief job interview script
answers: Manager: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Candidate: I’m a recent engineering graduate. I enjoy designing and solving problems.
Candidate: I’m organised, hardworking and a good team player.
Manager: Why do you want this job?
Candidate: I want to use my skills and learn from your team.
activities.note: Record with your partner, then assess fluency and accuracy after watching. Evaluation depends on the actual performance.

activities.title: How would you look for a job?
answers: I would use job search websites because I could compare many vacancies and apply quickly.

activities.label: Discussion
activities.title: Goals and direction
answers: The quote means that clear goals help us make useful choices. For example, choosing a career goal can help us decide what to study.
